name: Presidential Honors College Scholarship
provider: Palm Beach State College Honors College
description: Two-year award for graduating high school seniors entering the PBSC Honors College. Funds are available in fall, spring and summer.
renewal_requirements: Continue in a PBSC bachelor's program.

other_requirements: Participate in Honors College Gold Track.
Enroll in the fall term following high school graduation.
Cannot be combined with other Honors College scholarships.

name: Lynn University Grant
description: Need-based grant for full-time upper-class day undergraduates at Lynn University. Open to new and returning students.

name: Kevin and Michelle Clark Scholarship
provider: Florida Atlantic University Christine E. Lynn College of Nursing
description: Fulltime FAU Nursing student in good academic standing pursuing a nursing degree. Must be 1st generation college student in their freshman year of college.

name: Student Success Grant
description: For students returning to South University to finish a degree they didn't complete. Up to $3,375 for full-time students; capped at $1,625 part-time (undergraduate 6-11 credits, graduate 4-7 credits).

other_requirements: Returning South University student who previously did not complete their degree program.
Must begin classes between August 13, 2024 and December 31, 2027.
Undergraduates need at least 6 credits per term.
Not available to Anesthesia Science, Physician Assistant, or Pharmacy students.
See the Student Success Grant Memorandum of Understanding for full conditions.
